summary.interpretation: Delivered assistance is the outcome here, not intention recognition. No extra intention probe is run. The repair combines budget scheduling and card-state preservation, so their individual causal effects are not isolated. Model condition changes model family, size and training together; no claim about a parameter-count effect or causal percentage of blame.
limitations: Four authored development meetings (three help, one silence), not held-out, real ASR or a user study.
Repeats do not create independent scenarios. Contrasts are descriptive; label-uncertainty ranges are not confidence intervals.
Same token budget does not imply equivalent information capacity across model tokenizers; also report calls, output, wall time and incomplete observation.
The combined repair modifies budget scheduling and card-state preservation; this three-arm experiment does not isolate each component.
The cases previously revealed the failure modes and informed the repair; this is development regression, not held-out generalization.
Silent incomplete/error executions cannot establish successful restraint. No visible help cannot establish lack of understanding.
